notes: Security and ops hardening: nodemailer upgraded to 9 with hardened transport (file-access and URL-access disabled on the email-backup SMTP path), Electron upgraded to 42 for Chromium security patches, and electron-log now captures main-process uncaught exceptions/rejections, renderer unhandled errors, render-process-gone and child-process-gone crashes, and preload-load errors - all written to rolling log files in userData. The build pipeline now ships a dedicated Electron-ABI prebuild script (rebuild-electron-abi.mjs) and a boot smoke test (smoke-boot.mjs) that validates the full main-process startup under the real Electron binary. A GitHub Actions CI workflow is staged locally and ready to activate when the PAT gains workflow scope.
